title: 2027 pre-order launch plan
summary: Pre-orders open on 1 February with 10% off for returning customers. We stay with the current courier this season, subject to capacity for 2,000 boxes in March.

decisions.text: Stay with the current courier this season (₹82 per box against a ₹95 quote).
Open pre-orders on 1 February with 10% off for returning customers.

actions.action: Confirm the current courier's capacity for 2,000 boxes in March, in writing
Send the pre-order email to past customers

topics.title: Courier
points: Bluedart quoted ₹95 per box; the current partner charges ₹82.
Capacity for March is the open risk.
